question: What's the all-in damage, tax included, for your eight-month coding bootcamp?
reference: Full Stack Web Development (32 weeks, about 8 months) costs INR 1,46,320 including 18% GST (1,24,000 + 22,320 GST).

question: I've got a 9-to-5 job. Which of your programs could I realistically do alongside it?
reference: Data Analytics Pro and UI/UX Design Professional run on weekends, and Full Stack Web Development runs on weekday evenings, so all three are designed for working professionals.

question: If I score 90% on the aptitude test, how many rupees would the merit scholarship save me on the Full Stack course?
reference: 90% is above the 85% threshold, so the merit scholarship gives 15% off the Full Stack course fee of INR 1,24,000, a saving of INR 18,600 (discounts apply before GST).

question: I'll finish Python Foundations in February 2027 and then join the 10 April Data Analytics batch. What will the Data Analytics course fee be after the upgrade credit, before GST?
reference: Enrolling within 6 months of finishing Python Foundations gives an INR 5,000 credit, so the Data Analytics Pro course fee becomes 89,000 - 5,000 = INR 84,000 before GST.

question: For the Data Analytics batch starting 10 April 2027, what is the last day I can apply, and by when must I register to get the early bird discount?
reference: Applications close 10 days before the start, so by 31 March 2027. The early bird discount needs registration at least 30 days before the start, so by 11 March 2027.

question: If I do the Full Stack course in a classroom in Bengaluru, what's the centre's address and how much laptop RAM should I have?
reference: The Bengaluru centre is at 2nd Floor, Lakeview Plaza, Koramangala 5th Block, Bengaluru 560095. A laptop with 16 GB RAM is strongly recommended for Full Stack Web Development.

question: Can I get the Women in Tech scholarship on the UI/UX Design course?
reference: No. The Women in Tech scholarship (20% off) applies only to Data Analytics Pro and Full Stack Web Development, not UI/UX Design Professional.

question: Can I split the Digital Marketing fee into three instalments?
reference: No. The three-instalment plan is only for Data Analytics Pro, Full Stack Web Development and UI/UX Design Professional. Digital Marketing (course fee INR 45,000, above 40,000) can use no-cost EMI over 6 or 9 months, subject to credit approval, or be paid in full.

question: I enrolled in Python Foundations 3 days ago and have already watched about half the videos. Can I still get my money back?
reference: No. Python Foundations has a 7-day refund window only if you have watched less than 20% of the content. Having watched about half, you are not eligible for a refund.

question: What score do I need to pass the UI/UX design exercise?
reference: The documents don't give a pass mark for the UI/UX design exercise (they only say it takes about 2 hours, done at home). The 60% pass mark belongs to the aptitude test, not the design exercise.
